title: Unverbalized Harmful Reasoning: Detecting Superficial Safety Alignment (SSA)

original_idea.body: Detecting superficial safety alignment (extends SafeThinker arXiv:2601.16506, Qi et al. arXiv:2406.05946): score CoT and final answer separately on open reasoning models, count refuse-but-leak (SSA) cases, report SSA rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying refuse-but-leak SSA is a concrete deceptive-safety model-organism chain with real-harm implications.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CoT vs answer scoring with StrongReject across 2-3 models; labeling/judging adds labor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused SSA-rate deliverable; separate CoT/answer scoring is a bounded workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism, fuzzy-evaluation, open models, lab-deprioritized; strong counterfactual value.

novelty.reasoning: SSA named but prevalence not quantified across open models; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: SSA prevalence not quantified across open models.
